title: NatureMist Classic Trio
descriptionHtml:
A botanical collection for wash day.

NatureMist Classic Trio brings together Amla, Reetha and Shikakai in separate jars for your botanical hair-care routine.

What each jar brings

Amla offers a conditioning hair-mask step. Reetha is a botanical hair cleanser. Shikakai is a botanical hair cleanser.

What's inside

  • 1 jar of NatureMist Amla Powder
  • 1 jar of NatureMist Reetha Powder
  • 1 jar of NatureMist Shikakai Powder

One purchase includes all 3 separately packed jars. This is not a premixed formula.

Which jars can be used on skin?

Amla Powder can also be used separately for rinse-off skin rituals, following the skin-use directions on the pack. The other powders in this set are for hair care. Do not use the whole combination as a face mask.

How to use

Follow each product's directions for preparation, application and rinsing. Introduce one new powder at a time. Prepare fresh with clean water and discard leftover wet paste.

Care and storage

For external use only. Test on a small area before first use. Avoid eyes, inhaling powder, and irritated or broken skin. Stop use if irritation occurs. Strand-test light, grey, bleached or colour-treated hair. Keep powders dry and sealed, and use a clean, dry spoon.
